# Tool Library — Borrowing Pilot

One desk tested the tool-lending process from **11 September through 10 October 2026**. This folder separates dated observations from current rules. The [posted desk rules](sources/README.md) are source evidence; a meeting proposal does not change them by itself.

## Read the current view

- [Status](status.md) — objective, blockers, and next shift.
- [Borrowing policy](kb/borrowing-policy.md) — current rule, provenance, and exceptions.
- [Reminder workflow](kb/reminder-workflow.md) — day-five message and escalation boundary.
- [Returns and exceptions](kb/returns-and-exceptions.md) — check-in, damaged items, and unresolved cross-branch cases.
- [Metrics](kb/pilot-metrics.md) — the 10 October snapshot and its denominator.
- [Actions](actions.md) and [decisions](decisions.md) — commitments versus settled choices.

## Read the evidence

- [Journal](journal/README.md) — thirty dated desk notes across five weeks.
- [Meetings](meetings/README.md) and [weekly reviews](reviews/README.md) — what was observed and reconciled at the time.
- [Source register](sources/README.md) — the notice, message draft, and loan ledger extract.
- [Volunteer handbook](../handbook/README.md) — separately mounted procedure shared with other desks.

A [Mermaid flow](kb/reminder-workflow.md#flow) explains the reminder decision. The handbook includes a [local SVG check-in flow](../handbook/check-in/check-in-flow.svg). Both work offline in the viewer and HTML bundles.
